bounded_memory_method: Read-only source DBs plus a temporary key/rowid index; stream identity groups and gzip rows; retain only the 567-cell selection, finite counters and one identity group. No complete DB or occurrence table is copied.
evidence_boundary: Pending static text observations. Complete finite rule traversal does not imply semantic completeness. Variant counts can exceed logical identities; removed parent observations require explicit audits, and gap cells retain every parent record.
